title: Icon Kit
slide_intent: Use approved assets so small differences do not accumulate into an inconsistent interface.
strategic_value: A shared library can keep DB icons uniform across teams.
demonstration: A brief note supplies the starter-kit link and states that only official icons are used without modification.
practical_value: Download the official kit or consult the library instead of redrawing symbols.

content_islands.name: Asset instruction
content_islands.spec: Place the library explanation above the starter-kit download link.

reference_purposes.Application: The section directs designers to the starter kit and icon library.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Only official icons are to be used and they must not be modified.
